pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit high edge angularity with sharp, jagged pixel gradients and irregular, map-like boundaries. Spatial area of patches is significantly larger on the neck and reduces toward the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored interstitial pathways form a continuous topological graph with frequent tri-radial junctions. Pathways are relatively narrow and maintain high pixel-level continuity across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: An abrupt structural break or thinning in the mane's continuous line is visible at the transition point between the lower neck and the shoulder ridge.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Prominent localized patches of textural disruption and dark horizontal hyper-pigmentation are present on the upper shoulder and lower dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of parallel, horizontal linear scars or lesions are visible on the lower neck and shoulder area.
other_distinctive_markers: A small avian organism (oxpecker) is visible perched on the dorsal neck, creating a distinct localized anomaly in the silhouette.
